purpose: Test the smallest causal translation of the complete 9,368-chart V29 review: use the already frozen market state to decide which idiosyncratic tail has the natural long interpretation, then require one fixed session of both stock-level and broad-market acceptance before any order is eligible.

scientific_disclosure.why_post_hoc: The one-session acceptance hypothesis and the importance of same-date common market direction were learned after inspecting V29 development outcome charts.

rules: Keep the exact V29 mother: completed Friday close, above-normal causal stock-specific cross-sectional dispersion, one most-liquid top- or bottom-decile idiosyncratic tail per PIT industry, and the frozen 20-session symbol cooldown.

At the signal close, route exactly one tail from the already registered causal market state: BULL routes the UP tail; BEAR routes the DOWN tail; TRANSITION routes UP when the causal 20-session broad-market median return is positive and DOWN otherwise.
Observe exactly the next market session. The routed stock is accepted only when its fully valid same-lineage coordinate close is at or above its frozen signal coordinate close.

On that same exact confirmation session, require the broad PIT-eligible market cross-sectional median coordinate step return to be strictly positive with at least 500 securities; all source observations must be available by that completed-session decision time.

Only after the confirmation close, buy at the first legal non-limit-up coordinate open in signal sessions +2 through +4; use the unchanged +10% gross target, H20 first-sellable-open time exit, T+1, and 40 bp round-trip cost.
chart_review_compression.why_no_static_candlestick_filter: Across close visual matches, prior position, shock magnitude, one-bar shape, and turnover all had strong profitable and severe-loss counterexamples. The stable visual distinction was immediate acceptance after the shock plus strong same-date common fate, so the test makes that observation an explicit delayed decision instead of leaking it into the original entry.

one_session_confirmation.session: exact signal_cal_idx + 1 market session; no search over later confirmation windows
one_session_confirmation.stock_acceptance: candidate confirmation coordinate close >= frozen signal coordinate close
one_session_confirmation.market_acceptance: cross-sectional median step_return > 0 among at least 500 current hard-valid, tradable, trade_status=1, market-rule-valid, corporate-action-valid, non-blocking, historically identified, PIT-industry-valid, non-ST observations available by the confirmation close

outcome_blind_opportunity_gate.if_failed: Close V29R1 without reading its returns and without changing the router or confirmation definitions.

prohibited: 2022-2024 read before the strict annual development gate
